description: This Java source file implements the ProductPromoWorker class, a final utility class that handles catalog/product promotion functionalities within the OFBiz e-commerce framework. It contains methods to retrieve store promotions, check promotion conditions, apply promotions to a shopping cart, generate promotional descriptions, and manage promo code validations and limits, among other promotion-related operations.

classes.name: ProductPromoWorker
classes.description: Final utility class providing promotion handling functions such as retrieving store promotions, evaluating promotion conditions, applying promotions to shopping carts, generating descriptive summaries, and validating promo codes within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getStoreProductPromos
methods.description: Retrieves active product store promotions applicable to the current shopping cart session based on current timestamp, store configurations, and promotional rules.

methods.name: getStoreProductPromoCodes
methods.description: Returns the set of applicable promotion codes for the current shopping cart, considering store restrictions and active promotional codes.

methods.name: getProductStorePromotions
methods.description: Fetches list of product store promotions valid for the store, based on current timestamp and store promotion application entries.

methods.name: getAgreementPromotions
methods.description: Obtains promotions linked to customer agreements, filtering by current timestamp and agreement items.

methods.name: doPromotions
methods.description: Main entry point for applying all applicable promotions to the shopping cart: fetches promotions, runs promotion rules, sorts and limits promo application, and updates the cart accordingly.

methods.name: hasOrderTotalCondition
methods.description: Checks whether a given product promotion has any conditions related to the order total, to influence promotion calculation order.

methods.name: runProductPromos
methods.description: Executes the promotion rules across a list of promotions, iteratively applying relevant discounts or actions based on conditions until no further changes or max iterations reached.

methods.name: getProductPromoUseLimit
methods.description: Calculates the minimal use limit for a promotion considering per order, per customer, and per promotion constraints.

methods.name: getProductPromoCodeUseLimit
methods.description: Determines the remaining allowable uses of a given promotion code for the current party and order.

methods.name: checkCanUsePromoCode
methods.description: Validates whether a promotion code can be used by a specified party, providing reason messages if not valid.

methods.name: makeAutoDescription
methods.description: Generates a human-readable description of a promotion, including rules, conditions, actions, limits, and applicable parties.
